# Contributing

Thanks for wanting to help with `@erkle/cli`.

## We don't accept pull requests

Development happens in a private repository. This one receives a single commit
per release, so pull requests are turned off here.

## Report bugs as issues

If `npx @erkle/cli init` behaves differently than you expected,
**[open a bug report](https://github.com/erkle-ai/cli/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)**.
The fastest reports to fix include:

- the exact command you ran,
- the output, pasted verbatim,
- the `@erkle/cli` version (`npx @erkle/cli --version`), your Node version and OS,
- which agents you selected (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex).

Redact anything private (repository URLs, server URLs, paths) before posting.

## Security

Do not open a public issue for a vulnerability. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
